in_sanskrit.name: Kunu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little one, diminutive
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kunu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kunu originates from Sanskrit and translates to 'little one' or 'diminutive'. In Hindu mythology, it is a name given to the goddess Kali as an expression of her loving and nurturing aspect towards her devotees.
